title: Lost, Stolen and Misused Gift Cards & Store Credit: Locks, Unlocks and Replacement Eligibility
content:
When the holder of record reports a Gift Cards & Store Credit instrument lost, stolen or used without permission, the agent locks it with the matching reason, chosen from the lock reasons the instrument's type allows. Only value still on the instrument at the lock is protected; spending before the lock is never reimbursed.

## Unlocking

A locked instrument is unlocked only when both conditions hold:

| Holder confirms the card is back in their possession | Identity verification passed in the same contact | Unlock |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | No | No |
| No | Yes | No |
| No | No | No |

## Conditions of replacement

1. **Replaceable type.** A replacement is issued only for an instrument whose type is replaceable if lost.
2. **Settlement wait.** A replacement is issued only once the type's settlement wait in business days has passed since the instrument is locked. Business days run Monday to Friday excluding US federal holidays, the lock date is day zero, and the replacement may be issued on the day the count is reached. The lock date is read from the instrument's record.
3. **Ownership.** For a card whose type requires registration or proof, the card must have been registered to the caller's profile before the lock, or the caller must be the purchaser of record of the order line that bought it; a caller who only holds the card number is not enough.
4. **Replacement limit.** A customer can receive at most the type's limit of replacements in a trailing 12 months, counted as the customer's replacement transfers out dated within the trailing 12 calendar months; beyond that the case is handed to a human representative.

## The settlement wait on the calendar (hypothetical locks, wait of one business day)

| Lock date | Day zero | Earliest day a replacement may be issued |
|---|---|---|
| A Tuesday, with the Wednesday not a federal holiday | Tuesday | Wednesday (not the Tuesday itself) |
| A Friday, with the Monday not a federal holiday | Friday | Monday (not Saturday or Sunday) |
| A Friday, with the Monday a US federal holiday | Friday | Tuesday |

With a wait of zero business days, the count is reached on the lock date itself.

## Ownership cases (card type requiring registration or proof)

| Caller | Replacement possible on ownership grounds |
|---|---|
| Card registered to the caller's profile before the lock | Yes |
| Caller is purchaser of record of the order line that bought the card | Yes |
| Caller holds the card number only, card never registered to them, bought by someone else | No |
| Card registered to the caller only after the lock, caller not the purchaser | No |

## Retired clause

The following clause of this policy is **no longer in force** and is superseded by the current basis for replacement value: "The replacement is a new instrument of the replacement type, keeping the original expiry rules, loaded with the whole balance at the lock plus refunds received while locked; the old instrument closes with reason replaced and its transfer-out entry names the replacement as counterpart."

superseded_clauses: The replacement is a new instrument of the `replacement_variant`, keeping the original expiry rules, loaded with the whole balance at the lock plus refunds received while locked; the old instrument closes with reason replaced and its transfer-out row names the replacement as counterpart.
